query:
UPDATE rb_team_currency tc
        SET amount = GREATEST(
                0::NUMERIC,
                LEAST(
                    tc.amount::NUMERIC
                        + GREATEST(
                            FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($3 - tc.utime_at)) / 60),
                            0::NUMERIC
                        ) * (c.growth + tc.growth)::NUMERIC,
                    c.max_amount::NUMERIC
                )
            )::BIGINT,
            utime_at = GREATEST(tc.utime_at, $3)
        FROM rb_currency c
        WHERE tc.currency_id = c.id
            AND c.game_id = $1
            AND ($2::INT IS NULL OR c.id = $2);
